blocks.text: O'zbekchada egalikni ifodalovchi ta'rif ham otdan oldin turadi va ichidagi otga egalik qo'shimchasi qo'shiladi: «**mashinasi** o'g'irlangan odam», «**otasi** shifokor bo'lgan qiz». Inglizchada bunday ta'rif **whose** bilan boshlanadi va darhol egalik qilinayotgan ot keladi: the man **whose car** was stolen, a girl **whose father** is a doctor. **whose** — his / her / their / its ning o'rnini egallaydi: The man's car was stolen. → the man **whose** car was stolen. U asosan odamlar uchun, lekin narsa, shahar va tashkilotlar uchun ham ishlatiladi: a company **whose** profits are falling. Talaffuzi bir xil bo'lgani uchun **who's** (= who is / who has) bilan adashtirmang.

rows: a family **whose house** was damaged by the flood

items.text: I have a neighbour **whose** dog barks all night.
Tourists **whose** passports were lost should contact the embassy.
items.translation: **Pasporti** yo'qolgan sayyohlar elchixonaga murojaat qilishi kerak.

blocks.text: **whom** — who ning **to'ldiruvchi** shakli (him / her / them ga o'xshab). U faqat to'ldiruvchi o'rnida keladi, ega o'rnida hech qachon: the candidate **whom** we interviewed (biz unga suhbat o'tkazdik). **whom** rasmiy eshitiladi va asosan yozma matnda, rasmiy xat va nutqda uchraydi. So'zlashuvda uning o'rniga **who** yoki hech narsa ishlatiladi: the candidate (who) we interviewed (→ 93-dars). Predlog bilan ikki uslub bor: rasmiy — predlog **oldinda**: the person **to whom** I spoke; so'zlashuv — predlog **oxirida**: the person **I spoke to**. Predlogdan keyin faqat **whom** («to who» — xato).

items.text: The lawyer **whom** we hired was extremely professional.
The colleague **with whom** I share an office is from Fergana.
items.translation: **Men bilan bir xonada o'tiradigan** hamkasbim Farg'onadan.

items.text: The colleague **I share** an office **with** is from Fergana.
items.translation: **Men bilan bir xonada o'tiradigan** hamkasbim Farg'onadan. (so'zlashuv uslubi)

blocks.text: where, when, why — joy, vaqt, sabab

**where** — joy haqida ta'rif: the town **where** I grew up = the town (that) I grew up **in**. O'zbekchada «men **o'sgan** shahar» — `-da` qo'shimchasi yo'qoladi, inglizchada esa joy ma'nosini **where** o'z ichiga oladi. **when** — vaqt haqida: the day / the year / the moment **when** ... Bu yerda when ko'pincha tushib qoladi yoki that bilan almashadi: the day (**when / that**) we met. **why** — faqat **reason** dan keyin: the reason **why** she left; why ham ko'pincha tushadi yoki that ga almashadi: the reason (**that**) she left.

rows: the day (that) we met / the day we met
the reason (that) I called / the reason I called

items.text: This is the room **where** the treaty was signed.
I remember the moment **when** I first saw the Registan.
The reason **why** I'm late is the traffic on the ring road.

blocks.text: where yoki that / which? Fe'lni tekshiring

Joy haqida gapirilsa, har doim ham **where** kerak emas. Otni ta'rif ichidagi fe'lga qaytarib qo'yib tekshiring: I visited **the city** — fe'l to'g'ridan-to'g'ri to'ldiruvchi oladi, predlog yo'q → the city **(that)** I visited. I lived **in the city** — predlog bor → the city **where** I lived / the city I lived **in**. O'zbekchada bu farq ko'rinmaydi: «men **borgan** shahar» va «men **yashagan** shahar» — ikkalasi bir xil qolipda. Joy ta'rif ichida **ega** bo'lsa ham where emas: a hotel **that** has a pool («a hotel where has a pool» — xato).

items.text: Bukhara is the city **that** we visited first.
Bukhara is the city **where** we spent most of our holiday.
We need an office **that** has enough parking.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «the man who his car was stolen» → the man **whose** car was stolen (**who + his** emas, bitta **whose**); «the man **who's** car» → **whose** car; «the city where I visited» → the city (**that**) I visited (visit predlogsiz); «the house where I live **in**» → the house **where** I live / the house I live **in** (ikkalasi birga emas); «the reason **because** I left» → the reason **why** / **that** I left; «the person **to who** I spoke» → **to whom**.

O'zbekcha ta'rif ichidagi otda **egalik qo'shimchasi** bormi («**mashinasi**, **otasi**, **uyi**»)? Bor bo'lsa — **whose** + o'sha ot. Ta'rif joy, vaqt yoki sabab haqida bo'lsa — mos ravishda where / when / why, lekin where uchun avval fe'lni tekshiring: predlog kerakmi?

rows: a girl **whose** mother is a judge

examples.title: **whose**: the man **whose** car was stolen
examples.description: whose — his / her / their o'rnida, egalikni bildiradi. O'zbekchada: «mashinasi o'g'irlangan odam» — egalik qo'shimchali ot sifatdosh ichida keladi.

sentences.text: I know a woman **whose** son plays for the national football team.
sentences.translation: **O'g'li** milliy terma jamoada futbol o'ynaydigan bir ayolni taniyman.

sentences.text: The man **whose** car was stolen reported it to the police immediately.
sentences.translation: **Mashinasi** o'g'irlangan odam darhol politsiyaga xabar berdi.

sentences.text: We visited a family **whose** house had been damaged by the flood.
sentences.translation: **Uyi** seldan zarar ko'rgan bir oilani ko'rgani bordik.

sentences.text: Students **whose** parents work abroad can apply for extra support.
sentences.translation: **Ota-onasi** chet elda ishlaydigan talabalar qo'shimcha yordam uchun ariza bera oladi.

sentences.text: Aziz is the colleague **whose** desk is always covered in papers.
sentences.translation: Aziz — **stoli** doim qog'ozlarga to'lib yotadigan hamkasb.

sentences.text: Is that the girl **whose** brother you met in Oxford?
sentences.translation: Sen Oksfordda **akasi** bilan tanishgan qiz shumi?

sentences.text: The writer **whose** novel won the prize is only twenty-five.
sentences.translation: **Romani** mukofot olgan yozuvchi atigi yigirma besh yoshda.

sentences.text: I'm looking for the owner of the dog **whose** barking keeps me awake at night.
sentences.translation: **Akillashi** kechalari meni uxlatmayotgan itning egasini qidiryapman.

sentences.text: Dilnoza has a friend **whose** grandmother was born in London.
sentences.translation: Dilnozaning **buvisi** Londonda tug'ilgan bir dugonasi bor.

sentences.text: Passengers **whose** flights were cancelled were given free hotel rooms.
sentences.translation: **Reysi** bekor qilingan yo'lovchilarga bepul mehmonxona xonasi berildi.

examples.title: **whose** with things; **whose** or **who's**?
examples.description: whose narsa, shahar va tashkilotlar bilan ham keladi: a company whose profits ..., a city whose history ... who's (= who is / who has) bilan adashtirmang.

sentences.text: It's a company **whose** profits have doubled in two years.
sentences.translation: Bu — **foydasi** ikki yilda ikki baravar oshgan kompaniya.

sentences.text: Samarkand is a city **whose** history goes back more than 2,500 years.
sentences.translation: Samarqand — **tarixi** 2500 yildan ortiq davrga borib taqaladigan shahar.

sentences.text: They live in a house **whose** windows look out over the lake.
sentences.translation: Ular **derazalari** ko'lga qaragan uyda yashaydi.

sentences.text: **Who's** the man **whose** phone keeps ringing during the film?
sentences.translation: Film davomida **telefoni** jiringlayveradigan odam **kim**?

sentences.text: I bought a laptop **whose** battery lasts twelve hours.
sentences.translation: **Batareyasi** o'n ikki soat ishlaydigan noutbuk sotib oldim.

sentences.text: Do you know anyone **who's** been to the Aral Sea?
sentences.translation: Orol dengizida **bo'lgan** biror kishini bilasizmi?

sentences.text: The project **whose** budget was cut last month has been cancelled.
sentences.translation: O'tgan oy **byudjeti** qisqartirilgan loyiha bekor qilindi.

sentences.text: This is a plant **whose** leaves are used in traditional medicine.
sentences.translation: Bu — **barglari** xalq tabobatida ishlatiladigan o'simlik.

sentences.text: We need a supplier **whose** prices are lower and **whose** deliveries arrive on time.
sentences.translation: Bizga **narxlari** pastroq va **mahsuloti** o'z vaqtida yetib keladigan ta'minotchi kerak.

sentences.text: Name a country **whose** capital is not its largest city.
sentences.translation: **Poytaxti** eng katta shahri bo'lmagan bir davlatni ayting.

examples.title: **whom**: formal, and after prepositions
examples.description: whom — who ning rasmiy to'ldiruvchi shakli. Ko'pincha predlogdan keyin: to whom, with whom. So'zlashuvda: who ... to yoki who / whom umuman tushiriladi.

sentences.text: In the end, the committee chose a candidate **whom** everyone respected.
sentences.translation: Oxir-oqibat komissiya hamma **hurmat qiladigan** nomzodni tanladi.

sentences.text: The person **to whom** this letter is addressed no longer lives here.
sentences.translation: Bu xat **yo'llangan** odam endi bu yerda yashamaydi.

sentences.text: Who's the person **you were writing to**?
sentences.translation: **Xat yozayotgan** odaming kim?

sentences.text: The man **with whom** she founded the company later became her husband.
sentences.translation: U kompaniyaga **birga asos solgan** erkak keyinchalik uning eri bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Mr Brown is the teacher **whom** I respect most.
sentences.translation: Janob Braun — men **eng ko'p hurmat qiladigan** o'qituvchi.

sentences.text: All the patients **whom** the doctor examined today were children.
sentences.translation: Shifokor bugun **ko'rikdan o'tkazgan** bemorlarning hammasi bola edi.

sentences.text: Everyone **with whom** I worked in London was helpful and kind.
sentences.translation: Londonda **birga ishlagan** hamma odam yordamga tayyor va mehribon edi.

sentences.text: To **whom** should I send my application? — To the head of department.
sentences.translation: Arizamni **kimga** yuborishim kerak? — Bo'lim boshlig'iga.

sentences.text: Unfortunately, the colleague **who** I was complaining about heard everything!
sentences.translation: Afsuski, **men shikoyat qilayotgan** hamkasbim hammasini eshitib qolibdi!

sentences.text: For the report, we interviewed families **whom** the earthquake had left homeless.
sentences.translation: Hisobot uchun zilzila **uysiz qoldirgan** oilalar bilan suhbatlashdik.

examples.title: **where**: the town **where** I grew up
examples.description: where — joy haqida: the town where I grew up = the town I grew up in. O'zbekchada «men o'sgan shahar» — `-da` qo'shimchasi yo'qoladi.

sentences.text: This is the hospital **where** I was born.
sentences.translation: Bu — men **tug'ilgan** shifoxona.

sentences.text: Do you remember the restaurant **where** we had our first date?
sentences.translation: Birinchi uchrashuvimiz **bo'lgan** restoran esingdami?

sentences.text: The village **where** my grandparents live has no mobile signal.
sentences.translation: Bobom va buvim **yashaydigan** qishloqda mobil aloqa yo'q.

sentences.text: I'd like to live somewhere **where** it's warm all year round.
sentences.translation: Yil bo'yi iliq **bo'ladigan** biror joyda yashashni xohlardim.

sentences.text: Khiva is a town **where** you can feel the history in every street.
sentences.translation: Xiva — har bir ko'chasida tarixni his qilish **mumkin bo'lgan** shahar.

sentences.text: We found a café **where** students can work for hours without buying much.
sentences.translation: Talabalar ko'p narsa olmasdan soatlab **ishlay oladigan** kafe topdik.

sentences.text: That's the office **where** Tom worked before he moved to Manchester.
sentences.translation: Bu — Tom Manchesterga ko'chishidan oldin **ishlagan** ofis.

sentences.text: Is there a room **where** I can make a private phone call?
sentences.translation: Shaxsiy qo'ng'iroq **qila oladigan** xona bormi?

sentences.text: Bekzod showed us the school **where** he had studied as a boy.
sentences.translation: Bekzod bizga bolaligida **o'qigan** maktabini ko'rsatdi.

sentences.text: The beach **where** we usually swim was closed because of pollution.
sentences.translation: Biz odatda **suzadigan** plyaj ifloslanish tufayli yopilgan edi.

examples.title: **when**: the day (**when**) we met
examples.description: when — vaqt haqida: the day / the year / the moment (when) ... when ko'pincha tushib qoladi yoki that bilan almashadi: the day (that) we met.

sentences.text: I'll never forget the day **when** I got my first salary.
sentences.translation: Birinchi maoshimni **olgan** kunimni hech qachon unutmayman.

sentences.text: Do you remember the year **we moved** to Tashkent?
sentences.translation: Toshkentga **ko'chib kelgan** yilimiz esingdami?

sentences.text: Monday is the day **when** the museum is closed.
sentences.translation: Dushanba — muzey **yopiq bo'ladigan** kun.

sentences.text: There are moments **when** I miss my old job.
sentences.translation: Eski ishimni **sog'inadigan** paytlarim bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Summer is the time **when** most people take their holidays.
sentences.translation: Yoz — ko'pchilik ta'tilga **chiqadigan** vaqt.

sentences.text: The evening **that** we arrived in London, it was pouring with rain.
sentences.translation: Londonga **kelgan** kechamiz sharros yomg'ir quyib turgan edi.

sentences.text: 2020 was the year **when** everything changed for our business.
sentences.translation: 2020-yil — biznesimiz uchun hamma narsa **o'zgargan** yil bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Call me at a time **when** you're not too busy.
sentences.translation: Unchalik band **bo'lmagan** paytingizda menga qo'ng'iroq qiling.

sentences.text: That was the moment **I realised** I'd forgotten my passport.
sentences.translation: Aynan o'sha payt pasportimni unutib qo'yganimni **angladim**.

sentences.text: Madina still talks about the summer **when** she worked in a hotel in Edinburgh.
sentences.translation: Madina hali ham Edinburgdagi mehmonxonada **ishlagan** yozi haqida gapirib yuradi.

examples.title: **why**: the reason (**why**) ...
examples.description: why faqat reason so'zidan keyin keladi: the reason why ... why ko'pincha tushib qoladi yoki that bilan almashadi: the reason (that) I called.

sentences.text: The reason **why** I'm calling is to ask about your invoice.
sentences.translation: **Qo'ng'iroq qilayotganimning sababi** — hisob-fakturangiz haqida so'ramoqchiman.

sentences.text: Do you know the reason **why** the flight was delayed?
sentences.translation: Reys **kechikkanining sababini** bilasizmi?

sentences.text: Nobody understood the reason **she resigned** so suddenly.
sentences.translation: Uning to'satdan **ishdan ketish sababini** hech kim tushunmadi.

sentences.text: That's the main reason **why** we moved out of the city.
sentences.translation: Shahardan **ko'chib ketganimizning** asosiy sababi shu.

sentences.text: The doctor explained the reason **why** I kept getting headaches.
sentences.translation: Shifokor boshim tez-tez **og'riyotganining sababini** tushuntirdi.

sentences.text: Is there any reason **why** you can't come to the meeting?
sentences.translation: Yig'ilishga **kela olmasligingizga** biror sabab bormi?

sentences.text: One reason **that** tourists love Uzbekistan is the hospitality.
sentences.translation: Sayyohlar O'zbekistonni yaxshi **ko'rishining** sabablaridan biri — mehmondo'stlik.

sentences.text: Money isn't the reason **I changed** jobs — I wanted new challenges.
sentences.translation: Ish **almashtirganimning** sababi pul emas — yangi sinovlarni xohladim.

sentences.text: Kate told me the real reason **why** she and James broke up.
sentences.translation: Keyt menga Jeyms bilan **ajrashganining** asl sababini aytdi.

sentences.text: Lack of sleep is one of the reasons **why** students struggle in exams.
sentences.translation: Uyqusizlik — talabalarning imtihonlarda **qiynalishi** sabablaridan biri.

examples.title: **where** or **that**? Check the verb
examples.description: Joy haqida doim where emas! Fe'l predlogsiz to'ldiruvchi olsa (visit, see, sell) — that / which. Fe'l predlog talab qilsa (live in, be born in) — where. Joy ega bo'lsa ham — that.

sentences.text: Samarkand is the city **that** I visited last spring.
sentences.translation: Samarqand — men o'tgan bahor **borgan** shahar.

sentences.text: Samarkand is also the city **where** my father was born.
sentences.translation: Samarqand — otam **tug'ilgan** shahar ham.

sentences.text: The museum **that** we saw yesterday was built in the 19th century.
sentences.translation: Kecha biz **ko'rgan** muzey XIX asrda qurilgan.

sentences.text: The museum **where** we met was full of school groups.
sentences.translation: Biz **uchrashgan** muzey maktab o'quvchilari guruhlariga to'la edi.

sentences.text: Can you recommend a hotel **that** isn't too far from the station?
sentences.translation: Vokzaldan unchalik uzoq **bo'lmagan** mehmonxona tavsiya qila olasizmi?

sentences.text: Is there a hotel **where** we can bring our dog?
sentences.translation: Itimizni **olib kirsa bo'ladigan** mehmonxona bormi?

sentences.text: This is the park **which** the council wants to sell to developers.
sentences.translation: Bu — kengash quruvchilarga **sotmoqchi bo'lgan** bog'.

sentences.text: This is the park **where** I learned to ride a bike.
sentences.translation: Bu — men velosiped **haydashni o'rgangan** bog'.

sentences.text: Edinburgh is a city **that** attracts millions of visitors every August.
sentences.translation: Edinburg — har avgustda millionlab sayyohni **jalb qiladigan** shahar.

sentences.text: The flat **where** we lived in Oxford is the same flat **that** my parents rented thirty years ago.
sentences.translation: Oksfordda biz **yashagan** kvartira — ota-onam o'ttiz yil oldin **ijaraga olgan** kvartiraning o'zi.

examples.title: Mixed: **whose**, **whom**, **where**, **when**, **why**
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: whose, whom, where, when, why va that — real hayotdagi murakkabroq gaplarda.

sentences.text: I met a man **whose** daughter studies at the same university as Nilufar.
sentences.translation: **Qizi** Nilufar bilan bitta universitetda o'qiydigan bir kishi bilan tanishdim.

sentences.text: Bukhara is the city **where** my parents met and got married.
sentences.translation: Buxoro — ota-onam **tanishgan** va turmush qurgan shahar.

sentences.text: Do you remember the night **when** the power went off and we played cards by candlelight?
sentences.translation: Tok o'chib, sham yorug'ida karta **o'ynagan** kechamiz esingdami?

sentences.text: The reason **why** I didn't reply is that your email went into my spam folder.
sentences.translation: **Javob bermaganimning sababi** — xatingiz spam papkasiga tushib qolgan.

sentences.text: The witness **whom** the police wanted to question has left the country.
sentences.translation: Politsiya **so'roq qilmoqchi bo'lgan** guvoh mamlakatdan chiqib ketibdi.

sentences.text: Emma works for a charity **whose** aim is to bring clean water to villages.
sentences.translation: Emma **maqsadi** qishloqlarga toza suv yetkazish bo'lgan xayriya tashkilotida ishlaydi.

sentences.text: Is this the café **you told** me about, or is it the one **where** they make fresh juice?
sentences.translation: Bu sen menga **aytgan** kafemi yoki yangi sharbat **tayyorlaydigan** kafemi?

sentences.text: There was a time **when** nobody in our village had a phone.
sentences.translation: Qishlog'imizda hech kimda telefon **bo'lmagan** paytlar ham bo'lgan.

sentences.text: Parents **whose** children are under five get free entry to the zoo.
sentences.translation: **Farzandlari** besh yoshdan kichik bo'lgan ota-onalar hayvonot bog'iga bepul kiradi.

sentences.text: Sarah wants a job **where** she can use her languages and a boss **whose** style suits her.
sentences.translation: Sara tillarini **ishlata oladigan** ish va **uslubi** o'ziga mos keladigan rahbar topmoqchi.
